headline: Argentina makes three changes to starting XI for World Cup final
summary: Lionel Scaloni has announced the lineup for the clash against Spain, with Lionel Messi remaining the centerpiece of the attack.
details: Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni has announced the starting eleven for the 2026 FIFA World Cup final against Spain.
The defending champions will face Spain, the 2010 winners, at the New York-New Jersey Stadium in the United States on Sunday, July 19, at 1:00 AM Bangladesh time.
Compared to the semi-final victory over England (2-1), Scaloni has made three changes to the squad.
Gonzalo Montiel, Rodrigo De Paul, and Nicolas Gonzalez will replace Nahuel Molina, Leandro Paredes, and Julian Simeone.
The confirmed starting lineup includes defenders Gonzalo Montiel, Cristian Romero, Lisandro Martinez, and Nicolas Tagliafico.
The midfield consists of Rodrigo De Paul, Enzo Fernandez, Alexis Mac Allister, and Nicolas Gonzalez.
The attack is led by captain Lionel Messi and Julian Alvarez, relying on Messi's experience and Alvarez's speed to secure the trophy.
caption:
Three changes for the final! Argentina reveals their starting XI to face Spain for the World Cup title.

Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni has announced the starting eleven for the 2026 FIFA World Cup final against Spain.

The defending champions will face Spain, the 2010 winners, at the New York-New Jersey Stadium in the United States on Sunday, July 19, at 1:00 AM Bangladesh time.

Compared to the semi-final victory over England (2-1), Scaloni has made three changes to the squad.

Gonzalo Montiel, Rodrigo De Paul, and Nicolas Gonzalez will replace Nahuel Molina, Leandro Paredes, and Julian Simeone.

The confirmed starting lineup includes defenders Gonzalo Montiel, Cristian Romero, Lisandro Martinez, and Nicolas Tagliafico.

The midfield consists of Rodrigo De Paul, Enzo Fernandez, Alexis Mac Allister, and Nicolas Gonzalez.

The attack is led by captain Lionel Messi and Julian Alvarez, relying on Messi's experience and Alvarez's speed to secure the trophy.

headline_marked: 3 get [[life until death in 14-year-old child rape case]] in Thakurgaon
headline: 3 get life until death in 14-year-old child rape case in Thakurgaon
summary: A court has sentenced three individuals to life imprisonment until death for the rape of a 14-year-old girl in Thakurgaon.
details: A court in Thakurgaon has sentenced three men to life imprisonment until death for the gang rape of a 14-year-old girl.
The incident occurred in Thakurgaon, leading to alegal battle that concluded with the maximum possible sentence for the perpetrators.
The court's decision comes as a part of the ongoing efforts to combat sexual violence against children in Bangladesh.
The three convicts were found guilty of the upgraded charge of rape under the the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Act.
caption:
